## Database changes

<!-- Delete this section if there are none. -->

- [ ] New Prisma migration(s) included, and no applied migration was edited

- [ ] Seeds are still idempotent

## Checklist

- [ ] The project builds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Lint, format check, and tests pass (`npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test`)
- [ ] Follows [docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] Every new endpoint has DTO validation and Swagger decorators
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or `.env` files committed; `.env.example` updated if a variable was added
- [ ] Offline sync still works if the change touches order creation (idempotency key)
- [ ] Error messages shown to end users are in Spanish; code, comments, and docs are in English
- [ ] Docs updated (README) if applicable. `CHANGELOG.md` is generated by release-please
